notes.title: Full Controller Support Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43878526/6bbdf857ee7f10736f3972c3d2e55ee09898fe0e.png[/img]

[h2]Hello Wielders[/h2]
Not Only Nine now fully supports controller! Try it out and meow to your heart's content.

To accommodate this change, the battle system has also been overhauled. Keyboard/mouse players will now use WASD and the Arrow keys in battle, instead of only letter keys. This should make it easier to tell which key should be pressed, and make it feel a whole lot better!

There have been many quality of life updates and bug fixes over the past week since the demo's launch. One major update was adding clear "walls" to Orion Forest so you can visibly see where the level ends. I've also added various dialogue to NPC's to remind players of main story progression. 

Also, for those who struggled with the boss battle - there have been adjustments to make it more in-line with what a FIRST BOSS should be. Please forgive me for tuning it too high!

I'll be announcing this more formally later, but the Kickstarter page is up!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/larryzaur/not-only-nine]You can follow the Kickstarter here to be notified when it starts.[/url]
It will be going live May 1st, so please look forward to it.

Thank you for playing Not Only Nine. I hope to continue to make changes that help make the game a much better experience for everybody.

Till All Complete!
